name: Pigeon
description: A single-file H5 parcel tracker whose world model is permission. Every parcel sits at a point on its own journey and what you may do to it follows from that point alone: an address can be moved while the parcel is at the depot but not once it is on the van, safe-place instructions close when the driver sets off, a parcel can only be reported missing after a delivery attempt, and a return has fourteen days from delivery. Seven parcels are seeded at seven different points, so for any given rule exactly some of them qualify — and every refusal names the rule that stopped it. 11 screens, 4 pickup points, 3 addresses.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — each parcel's stage, its scan history and the reason any action is refused all serialise as text.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view keyed by parcel name. For the verifier only.

world.stages: label created, collected, on its way, at your depot, out for delivery, delivered; plus attempted and going back
world.rules: reschedule needs a depot or a failed attempt; an address change closes when the van loads; safe place closes at the same moment; a divert needs the parcel to be in transit or at the depot; missing needs a delivery or an attempt; a return needs delivery within the last 14 days
world.refusals: every blocked action returns the reason as a toast rather than a disabled button, so an agent can read why
